name: v253_actual_vector_largecap_subindustry
hypothesis: The broad actual-vs-estimate vector is strong but TOP1000-fragile; a larger-cap gate and subindustry control may preserve delivery surprise while reducing small-cap dependence.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.60, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank((vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank((vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_qf_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_qf_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), subindustry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_previosestimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_previosestimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry), -1)
notes: Direct LSUS repair of 6XwQrrbK: cap gate 0.60, SUBINDUSTRY, no old stabilizers.

name: v253_actual_vector_simplified_largecap
hypothesis: If LSUS failure is caused by noisy absolute-surprise and revision-range terms, a simplified large-cap delivery surprise should keep only the robust core.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.60, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank((vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank((vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_qf_v4_nd_actual) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate) - vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_previosestimate)) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_30_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
notes: Signal simplification: removes absolute residual legs and uses one market-correlation stabilizer only.

name: v253_actual_vector_rankspace_unitsafe
hypothesis: Rank-space actual-minus-estimate delivery avoids raw mixed-unit vector arithmetic and may improve robustness if the original signal is driven by cross-sectional delivery ordering rather than magnitude.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate)), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_qf_v4_nd_actual)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate)), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_basic_af_v4_nd_actual)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_af_v4_nd_estimate))), 126), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_actual_qf_v4_nd_actual)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_basic_qf_v4_nd_estimate))), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_30_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
notes: Rank-space unit-safe repair. Reject on syntax issues, warning, LSUS, or high corr to analyst delivery actives.
